    The odd quotients of even A (Appendix A) #

    That paper, "The odd quotients of even A": with all mesh coefficients one, "a correction to an arrow gives a relation between a row path and its one-arrow rotation, with opposite classes"; rows are reduced by the sum of their levels to words in the middle arrows ε, and "going around the cycle gives w_j = -w_j".

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

                (starTree L).rowZ hQ π c m P = 0

                Middle words vanish: rotating a word in the middle arrows c₀ times gives its image under the deck generator with the sign (-1)^{c₀} = -1, so twice its class is zero.
